Class WeakIdentityHashMap<K,V>

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractMap<K,V>
io.netty.util.internal.WeakIdentityHashMap<K,V>
All Implemented Interfaces:
Map<K,V>
public final class WeakIdentityHashMap<K,V> extends AbstractMap<K,V>
A Map with the properties of both IdentityHashMap and WeakHashMap. Implementation is based on open-addressing. Not intended for more than a few thousand entries.

null keys and values are not supported by this implementation.

This class is not thread-safe.
